Platform Architecture

Everything Your Healthcare Dietary Kitchen Needs

See the real screens used by dietary managers, clinical dietitians, and line cooks every day.

1. MENU PLANNING & RECIPES

4-Week Seasonal Cycle Menu Planner

Configure 4 weeks of breakfast, lunch, and dinner with daily alternate choices. When you scale a recipe yield, portion sizes and procurement orders calculate automatically.

  • Choice A / Choice B daily resident meal options
  • Master recipe book with automatic USDA allergen matching
  • 1-click batch cook sheet printouts with scaled ingredient yields
2. CLINICAL DIET ORDERS & CENSUS

Resident Diets & IDDSI Texture Orders

Maintain active clinical diet orders with zero lag. Track low-sodium, diabetic, renal diets, IDDSI pureed and minced textures, allergen profiles, and dining room seating.

  • Census & Diet Order CSV Importer: Import existing census files in seconds with audit versioning
  • IDDSI Level 3, 4, 5, 6 dysphagia texture badges
  • Deterministic NPO and allergy stop-warnings
  • PointClickCare EHR integration connects directly to your PCC tenant (Enterprise)
3. KITCHEN TABLET & HACCP

Gloved Touch Tablet & HACCP Temp Logger

Mount an inexpensive tablet directly at the cook station or tray line. Cooks view required portions, record genuine food temps into the tamper-evident HACCP log, and print thermal tray cards.

  • Large 44px+ touch targets designed for gloved cooks
  • Bluetooth probe support — zero simulated or fake temperatures
  • 4" x 6" Thermal tray card printing with safe fallback
  • Durable HACCP logging with mandatory corrective-action notes
4. PROCUREMENT & SPLIT MRP

Multi-Distributor Split MRP Ordering

Stop overpaying by single-sourcing food. Shoreline explodes cycle menu recipes against current Dennis and Sysco contracted order guides, automatically routing each line item to the lowest-cost distributor.

  • Line-item contract price comparator across Dennis & Sysco
  • Case-pack conversion and rounding logic to eliminate split-case fees
  • 3-way invoice match with automated credit claim memos
  • Live Cost-Per-Resident-Day ($/CPD) spend tracking
5. "CUT+DRY" STYLE SKU MATCH & PRICE MATRIX

Cross-Vendor Catalog Matcher & Price Spread

Distributors deliberately obfuscate pack sizes (40/4oz vs 2/10 lb) so you can't compare prices. Shoreline's mathematical pack normalizer unlocks true apples-to-apples $/lb and $/fl oz unit economics.

  • CSV Catalog Uploader: Drop in distributor price sheets to auto-match SKUs
  • Fuzzy Culinary Abbreviations: Maps "chk brst b/s" to canonical Boneless Chicken Breast
  • Winner Badges & Spread %: Instant green badge on the lowest $/unit vendor
  • Distributor PO Desk: Reps can view and acknowledge orders directly in the portal

Developer & Integration Platform

Built to Integrate. Designed to Extend.

ShorelineOps ships with a unified CLI, MCP server, and REST API — giving developers, operators, and AI agents programmatic control over every module.

Unified CLI

Control every module from your terminal, CI/CD pipeline, or automation scripts.

shoreline residents --json

MCP Server

5 production-ready Model Context Protocol tools for connecting AI agents and workflows.

shoreline mcp tools

SDK & Webhooks Available

TypeScript SDK and webhook events for EHR triage, HACCP alerts, and CPD budget variance. Live REST spec at /api/docs.

npm i @shoreline/sdk
Quick CLI Reference
shorelineresidents--json
shorelinesurvey cms-binder
shorelinepurchasing split-po
shorelinedoctor
All commands support --json for machine-readable output • REST API on port 3001

Self-Hosting Guide

How to Deploy Your Own SaaS Version in 3 Steps

Deploy your facility's cloud instance using Vercel (frontend hosting) and Supabase (cloud database). Both offer generous free tiers.

1

Create Free Supabase Project

Sign up at supabase.com. Create a new project, go to Project Settings → API, and copy your URL and anon public key.

Free cloud PostgreSQL database
2

1-Click Deploy to Vercel

Click the button below to fork and deploy the repository directly to your Vercel account with automatic builds and SSL.

Deploy to Vercel
3

Set Environment Variables

In your Vercel project configuration, enter your Supabase connection credentials:

VITE_SUPABASE_URL=https://...
VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=...
✓ Ready for production
